verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a transfer-in flow with at-cost transfer pricing shown upfront. It also says most transfers add one year from the current expiration date, so remaining registration time is kept. Troubleshooting docs cover registrar locks (clientTransferProhibited) and transfers that miss the expected time frame. One user reports smooth transfers that took minutes, but others report a duplicate renewal charge after a transfer and a charge that never showed up in the domain's expiration date. Those reports weaken the honest-billing part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the EPP/auth-code step, a dedicated transfer status-tracking view, a clear statement of which transfers get no one-year extension, and consistent hands-on corroboration that billing matches the expiration extension.
